name: Commitments
description: Moss reads your email and chats and suggests things you said you would do. You review each suggestion and mark it done or dismiss it.

settings.label: Commitments
settings.description: Commitments has no settings page. Review pending suggestions in the Commitments section on Today.

features.description: A person can list the commitment suggestions Moss found, filter them by status, open one with its saved evidence, and accept it, reject it, snooze it or mark it as not owed. Each person sees only their own suggestions. Extraction and the email check run as background jobs and a person can queue one with the extract route.

errors.description: The suggestion does not exist or belongs to another person. Check the suggestion and try again.

features.description: A suggestion can be dismissed as not owed when another suggestion that is already marked not owed is named as the reason.

errors.description: The suggestion named as the reason is not marked as not owed. Mark it first, then try again.

features.description: Marking a suggestion as resolved needs a check that the linked task or draft exists. That check is not connected yet, so every resolve request is refused as unavailable and nothing is saved.

errors.description: Resolving suggestions is not available yet. Nothing was changed.

features.description: Today shows Things you said you would do below the day plan. Accept, reject or snooze a saved suggestion until tomorrow, next week or a chosen date. The section is hidden when there is nothing to review. There is no separate navigation entry or settings pane. Extraction still runs only when requested.

errors.description: Suggestions could not load or a change could not be saved. Use Try again; a failed change leaves the suggestion in place.

features.description: The package supplies review tools and a reusable approval card based on a saved suggestion. Live Rust chat review waits on the Rust chat tools and approval cards task.
Accepted commitments with a due date can appear in Moss check-ins. Check-ins read saved commitments only.

errors.description: Commitments could not be read for a check-in. The next check tries again.

features.description: Package chat tools read suggestions and change their status after approval. The Rust chat host does not connect these tools yet. Resolving a suggestion is still unavailable.
Checked what new email asks of you

Email suggests commitments only when you wrote in the conversation. Unanswered questions stay eligible and answered threads are skipped. Email and People supply the thread and the sender, and a missing helper is noted and skipped. Chat and notes text is read only when a helper module supplies it. None does yet, so those runs finish with nothing found.
A person can ask Moss to read one source again for new commitments. The request is queued and the answer comes back at once.

errors.description: The source must be chat, email or notes. Pick one of those and try again.

commitments.heartbeatOpen.description: Background read of accepted commitments that are due soon or recently overdue, with a change revision.

commitments.list.description: List the commitment suggestions that have been found so far.

commitments.threadJudgements.description: Say which email threads were already judged, when, and with what outcome. No message text.

commitments.get.description: Show one commitment suggestion with its saved evidence.

commitments.accept.description: Accept a commitment suggestion after the person approves.

commitments.reject.description: Reject a commitment suggestion after the person approves.

commitments.snooze.description: Snooze a commitment suggestion until a date after the person approves.
